title: The Twin Captains' Transponder
logline: A merchant pilot running identical ships with his twin brother discovers their transponder swap has entangled him in an execution bounty placed on his sibling's debts.

roles.description: Legitimate freight hauler; panic-stricken, desperate to prove he is not the brother who defaulted on syndicate loans.
Ruthless private enforcer authorized by municipal creditors to scuttle defaulted hulls on sight.
A heavy patrol gunboat carrying military tracking sensors and pulse disruptors.
The association of licensed freight traders attempting to maintain legal registration codes.
The predatory financing syndicate holding default bounties across border shipping lines.
The primary inspection ring where commercial hull signatures and transponder arrays are certified.
A lawless drift zone in the asteroid shadows where unregistered ships swap identification plates.
The station court where commercial identity disputes and bounty warrants are adjudicated.

public_situation: {role:creditor_syndicate} posts an execution bounty for a delinquent freighter transponder, sending {role:hunter_corvette} to patrol approach corridors.
private_truth: {role:hunted_twin} swapped transponder crystals with his twin brother at {role:salvage_creek} to evade docking tariffs, unaware his brother had defaulted on syndicate debt.

beats.public_change: Bounty alerts flash across station customs boards while security cruisers scan arriving cargo hulls.

missions.reason: He needs an independent pilot to retrieve his authentic encrypted transponder crystal from a maintenance locker before bounty hunters breach his hangar.
missions.private_fact: He has been hiding in his ship's cargo bilge for eighteen hours while hunter drones scan his hull.

beats.public_change: {role:hunter_corvette} anchors across the primary departure channel, firing sensor probes into outer berths.

missions.reason: He needs a pilot to scan the swap shop terminal at the salvage drift to extract the encrypted logs of his brother's original debt note.
missions.private_fact: His twin deliberately arranged the identity swap knowing the syndicate's kill-order would fall on the first ship intercepted.

beats.public_change: {role:hunter_corvette} locks weapon tethers onto the merchant hull, demanding immediate surrender.

missions.reason: He needs the bounty hunter's corvette disabled before its tactical weapons puncture his vessel's reactor shielding.
missions.private_fact: The bounty hunter hails offering forty thousand credits and clean identification papers if the pilot hands over the twin.

beats.public_change: Magistrates convene an emergency admiralty session at {role:arbitration_hall} to determine title forfeiture.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the authentic transponder crystal and identity telemetry to the magistrate's bench to cancel the bounty warrant.
missions.private_fact: If the magistrate clears him, the bounty will automatically transfer to his twin, who is hiding in the next system.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot stands before the magistrate as the bounty factor demands immediate hull forfeiture.

options.label: Submit the authentic transponder proof to clear the merchant and redirect the bounty
Propose an identity settlement splitting the debt between both brothers without violence
Sell the telemetry proof to the bounty factor to collect the syndicate reward

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot presents the authentic transponder proof to the magistrate.
resolutions.summary: The magistrate verifies the original transponder. {role:hunted_twin} is cleared of all debts, and the syndicate bounty is redirected to his fugitive brother.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot untangled a swapped transponder core in court to save a panicked merchant from an execution bounty meant for his brother.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot brokers a split repayment compromise between the brothers.
resolutions.summary: A settlement is reached. The magistrate mandates a repayment plan split between both vessels, lifting the kill-order and placing the twins under commercial supervision.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot accepts the bounty hunter's deal and surrenders the twin.
resolutions.summary: The pilot takes the bounty hunter's deal. {role:creditor_syndicate} impounds {role:hunted_twin}'s ship, forcing him into penal freight service to pay his brother's debt.

consequences.public_summary: Freight crews whisper about a pilot who collected a syndicate payout by handing an innocent trader over to bounty collectors.

resolutions.reached_by: Telemetry delivery fails or the arbitration hearing expires.
resolutions.summary: The bounty corvette corners the freighter and disables its core. {role:hunted_twin} is captured, and his vessel is scrapped to satisfy default claims.

loose_threads.detail: A customs bulletin notes two identical freighters checking through opposite jump gates within twelve minutes under one callsign.
A debt liquidation board posted an execution bounty on a hull transponder registered three hours before the promissory default.
An unmonitored beacon in the asteroid shadows transmits repeated transponder handshake protocols on encrypted syndicate channels.

radio_hooks: Station constabulary warns commercial shipping of armed enforcement patrols near perimeter berths.
Creditor syndicate reaffirms lawful authorization of vessel repossession bounties.
Merchants exchange reminds members that transponder tampering carries immediate charter cancellation.

voice_direction.hunted_twin: High-strung, stammering, and breathless with terror. Frequently repeats that he is the honest brother and pleads for someone to check his cargo manifests.
voice_direction.bounty_factor: Flat, mechanical, and bored. Treats lethal bounty contracts like routine deliveries and refers to human targets strictly by their transponder hull codes.
